nodes.label: Planned vs walked route chart (WP1-WP5, dashed plan vs solid walked)
nodes.norm_label: planned vs walked route chart (wp1-wp5, dashed plan vs solid walked)

nodes.norm_label: post-eva checklist (2/4 done: dust-off/suit doff, sample bagging, suit recharge, dose log upload)

nodes.norm_label: status chip pattern (green safe / yellow caution pill)

nodes.norm_label: top bar (brand, eva-07 jezero west, tab nav, sol clock, mrs-l3 link, safe status)

nodes.label: Dark theme with Mars-orange accent
nodes.rationale: Low-glare dark UI for field use; orange reserved for brand, active tab, focus and now-line.

nodes.label: Orange corner-bracket focus on current item (Top up O2 and power)

nodes.norm_label: link budget / pass prediction segmented toggle
nodes.rationale: Comms is split into two sub-views (link and passes) sharing one header to avoid adding top-level tabs.

nodes.norm_label: mrs-l1 relay marker (el 25 deg) with pass arc

nodes.norm_label: uplink margin across the sky (half-dome elevation chart)

nodes.label: Safe / Caution status pills
nodes.rationale: Green/yellow dot pills translate numeric margin into a categorical safety state, consistent with the global Safe pill in the top bar.

nodes.label: Theta-min 19.9 deg cutoff (red dashed line, maroon no-link zone)
nodes.norm_label: theta-min 19.9 deg cutoff (red dashed line, maroon no-link zone)
nodes.rationale: Callout 'below it the uplink does not close' makes the minimum elevation threshold explicit; maroon shading marks unusable sky.

nodes.label: Top nav bar (MARSWALK, EVA-07 Jezero West, Hub/Plan/EVA Map/FoV/Comms/Debrief, SOL 412 clock, MRS-L3 signal, Safe pill)
nodes.norm_label: top nav bar (marswalk, eva-07 jezero west, hub/plan/eva map/fov/comms/debrief, sol 412 clock, mrs-l3 signal, safe pill)
nodes.rationale: Persistent mission context (sol, local Mars time, relay, safety status) visible on every screen; active tab underlined in orange accent.

nodes.label: Transmit suit -> relay link budget waterfall (margin +2.0 dB, Caution)
nodes.norm_label: transmit suit -> relay link budget waterfall (margin +2.0 db, caution)
nodes.rationale: Mirrors the receive chart in reverse direction so the weaker uplink (outage 28.5%) is flagged with yellow Caution status.

nodes.label: Comms screenshot (Relay link - MRS constellation, Link budget tab)
nodes.norm_label: comms screenshot (relay link - mrs constellation, link budget tab)
nodes.rationale: Dark-theme iPad screen that turns a statistical UHF relay link budget into glanceable go/no-go information for an EVA crew member: where in the sky the link closes, how often it fails, and per-direction margin.

nodes.label: Contact windows timeline (next 6 h)
nodes.rationale: Horizontal Gantt-like strip 15:30-21:30 LMST with relay chips (L1,L3,L1,L2,L3,L4,L2) and a now cursor; notes EVA ends 17:05 to relate coverage to EVA duration.

nodes.label: Pass coverage statistics panel
nodes.rationale: Passes per sol 11, usable 9 of 11, mean contact 9.8 min, longest gap 54 min, coverage during EVA 71%.

nodes.label: Link prediction pass list
nodes.rationale: Each row: relay, time window, duration, max elevation, uplink margin in dB. Margins use the uplink as the weaker direction (conservative). Negative-margin pass flagged 'below 0min'. Active pass highlighted with orange corner brackets.

nodes.label: Link budget / Pass prediction segmented toggle
nodes.norm_label: link budget / pass prediction segmented toggle
nodes.rationale: Comms screen has two sub-views; this screenshot shows Pass prediction selected, the sibling being the comms link budget view.

nodes.label: Relay orbit view (Mars disc with 4 relay ellipses)
nodes.norm_label: relay orbit view (mars disc with 4 relay ellipses)
nodes.rationale: 4 relays at 400 km in 3 orbital planes, propagated from synthetic elements; shows each relay's position (MRS-L1..L4) relative to the user's site.

nodes.label: Orange corner-bracket selection marker
nodes.rationale: Same bracket motif marks the in-view relay both on the orbit map and in the list, linking the two views visually.

nodes.label: Jezero West site callout (next usable pass, max elevation, margin)
nodes.norm_label: jezero west site callout (next usable pass, max elevation, margin)
nodes.rationale: Anchored 'You' marker with coordinates 18.43N 77.42E, -2410 m; summarizes the next usable pass (16:42 LMST, 62 deg, +3.1 dB).

nodes.label: Sync passes to HUD primary action
nodes.norm_label: sync passes to hud primary action
nodes.rationale: Orange full-width primary button pushes pass schedule to the suit HUD; secondary text action 'Export elements'.

nodes.label: Marswalk top bar (EVA-07, nav tabs, SOL clock, relay signal, Safe status)
nodes.norm_label: marswalk top bar (eva-07, nav tabs, sol clock, relay signal, safe status)
nodes.rationale: Shared chrome: tabs Hub/Plan/EVA Map/FoV/Comms/Debrief with Comms active (orange underline); SOL 412 15:38 LMST; connected relay MRS-L3; green Safe pill.

nodes.label: Comms Passes screenshot (Relay passes over Jezero West)
nodes.norm_label: comms passes screenshot (relay passes over jezero west)
nodes.rationale: Comms tab in Pass prediction mode: split layout with an orbital geometry view on the left and a ranked pass list with link margins on the right, so the crew can pick relay windows that overlap the EVA.

nodes.label: Marswalk design tokens
nodes.rationale: Components use semantic tokens only.

nodes.label: Data honesty
nodes.rationale: All terrain, telemetry, dose, relay data is synthetic; screens label it, routes are 'planned', verdict is a planning aid.

nodes.label: 06 Comms Pass Prediction (#/comms/passes)
nodes.rationale: Shares one Comms tab with Link Budget via a small switch.

nodes.label: Three raster image placeholders
nodes.rationale: Missing images show a neutral surface plus a status line naming the file; to be replaced with licensed NASA imagery.

nodes.label: Marswalk EVA Planner
nodes.rationale: Single-EVA planner front-end prototype for NASA Space Apps Jakarta; all numbers synthetic or modelled.

nodes.norm_label: nasa space apps jakarta: interplanetary survival guide: martian map

nodes.norm_label: stack: vite, react 19, typescript, tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, fontsource
nodes.rationale: Fonts (Geologica, Urbanist) bundled via Fontsource so the app works offline; relative base path so dist/ hosts anywhere.

nodes.label: mars-basemap.jpg
nodes.rationale: 3840x1920 equirectangular Solar System Scope texture placeholder.

nodes.rationale: Matches iPad Pro 12.9in landscape Figma frames.

nodes.rationale: Keyboard users get a confirm dialog instead.

nodes.rationale: Map camera is the only smooth movement; durations/easings in motion.css read from CSS variables in JS.

nodes.label: Dark UI with Mars-orange accent
nodes.rationale: Low-glare dark surfaces; orange reserved for active tab, waypoints, current position and focus brackets.

nodes.norm_label: live telemetry (heart rate, suit pressure, co2 partial, outside temp; 1 hz simulated)

nodes.norm_label: map search and controls (search, compass, recenter, zoom)

nodes.norm_label: status pill pattern (safe green / caution yellow)
